name: Payroll System API
description:
Multi-tenant payroll management system with PPh 21 and BPJS support for Indonesia.

## Features
- Multi-tenant architecture (company-based isolation)
- Employee management
- Payroll processing (monthly)
- PPh 21 tax calculation (TER & legacy methods)
- BPJS calculation (Kesehatan & Ketenagakerjaan)
- Time & attendance tracking
- Leave management
- Overtime tracking
- Reimbursement processing
- Role-based access control (RBAC)
- Comprehensive reporting
- SaaS subscription management

## Authentication
Uses Bearer token (JWT) authentication. Include token in Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <your_token>
```

## Rate Limiting
- Standard endpoints: 60 requests/minute
- Export/Report endpoints: 10 requests/hour
- Login endpoint: 5 attempts/15 minutes

## Versioning
API is versioned via URL path: `/api/v1/...`

## Multi-tenant
All requests are automatically scoped to the authenticated user's company.
No need to pass company_id in requests (handled by backend).
